g.text: Study design for evaluating language-conditioned segmentation reliability
Observational case-level evaluation, failure localization, ground-truth-free risk assessment, and controlled representation intervention
Multiple descriptions of the same target

Observational analyses characterize where language-conditioned variation occurs; the intervention separately tests whether controlled movement of the projected text representation produces ordered movement of localization.
